notes.title: Build a Bot Demo Release!
notes.content: [h2]The Demo is now live![/h2][p]We at DESKRAGE are happy to finally get out a free demo of Build a Bot into your hands! It's intended as a sneak preview of what we are working on and we may throw an update or two when we have something interesting to show.[/p][p][/p][p]So...[/p][h3]What is in the Demo?[/h3][list][*][p]Most of the second level of the game including one of the bosses from the game[/p][/*][*][p]8 Gun options to mix and match[/p][/*][*][p]A good pile of chips to make your own unique builds[/p][/*][*][p]5 enemy types to test you mettle against[/p][/*][*][p]3 room types: Extermination, Survive and Capture the Point[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][url="https://linktr.ee/deskrage_games" style="button"]Keep up with us on our socials![/url][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: - Most of the second level of the game including one of the bosses from the game
- 8 Gun options to mix and match
- A good pile of chips to make your own unique builds
- 5 enemy types to test you mettle against
- 3 room types: Extermination, Survive and Capture the Point
